summary: The customer's basement water heater will not stay lit and there has been a rotten egg smell near it since this morning.

job_type.quote: our water heater in the basement isnt staying lit

urgency.quote: theres a smell like rotten eggs down there since this morning
urgency.why: A rotten egg smell next to a heater that will not stay lit is a possible risk to people and the building, although the customer only asks for today.

safety.what: Rotten egg smell in the basement, strongest by the water heater, present since the morning.
safety.quote: theres a smell like rotten eggs down there since this morning. kind of strong by the heater

ask_first: Is anyone in the house right now?
Can you smell it anywhere else in the house, or only in the basement?
Is the smell getting stronger, staying the same, or fading?
Has anyone been trying to relight the heater?
notes: The customer describes this as a water heater repair and asks for someone today. They do not mention gas or treat the smell as urgent.
The smell has been there since the morning, so it has had hours to build up.
The message does not say outright that the heater is gas. That it "isnt staying lit" suggests it is.
